name: 5F-AB-FUPPYCA
summary: 5F-AB-FUPPYCA (also known as AZ-037) is a pyrazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be an agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. It was first detected by the EMCDDA as part of a seizure of 540 g white powder in France in February 2015.

pharmacology.text: 5F-AB-FUPPYCA (also known as AZ-037) is a pyrazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be an agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. It may be considered an analog of the traditional pyrazole cannabinoid receptor 1 antagonist rimonabant.

uses.text: 5F-AB-FUPPYCA (also known as AZ-037) is a pyrazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be an agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. The pharmacological properties of 5F-AB-FUPPYCA have not been studied.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its core is a pyrazole ring, which makes it a cousin of rimonabant, a diet drug withdrawn in Europe because it blocked the same cannabinoid receptor and caused depression.
fact.zh: 它的核心是吡唑環，因此與利莫那班（rimonabant）同屬一類；利莫那班是一種減肥藥，因為阻斷同一個大麻素受體並引起憂鬱而在歐洲下市。
fact.zhHans: 它的内核是吡唑环，因此与利莫那班（rimonabant）同属一类；利莫那班是一种减肥药，因为阻断同一个大麻素受体并引起忧郁而在欧洲下市。
